description.value: Cibo Trattoria is an award-winning Italian restaurant housed inside the Moda Hotel in downtown Vancouver's arts and cultural district, recognized as Best New Restaurant in Canada by EnRoute Magazine in 2009 and holder of the Ospitalita Italiana Seal. The intimate 40-seat dining room follows the Slow Food philosophy, building seasonal menus entirely from scratch using ethically sourced local ingredients. A private dining room seats up to 10 for group events, and takeout is available through Uber Eats and DoorDash.
